A small black bag containing herbal medication was located in the room, which after translation from Korean revealed the prescription was issued to "PARK, Seng Dae"(variation of spelling PARK, Sang Dae).  It should be noted that the bus ticket-stub was located with the deceased identified "DUNG" as the individual who purchased the ticket.
Numerous checks were made with variety of agencies in an attempt to determine the man's identity.  It is believed he may be of Korean or Chinese decent.

Ryan purchased camping equipment in Medicine Hat, Alberta in May of 2017. Some of his possessions were recovered along the South Saskatchewan River in late May.

Case reference: 2012020078.CaseDesc: Anthony Whitehead was last seen on June 2, 1990, at a party on the Gordon First Nation in Saskatchewan. Despite searches and investigations over the years, Anthony has not been located.

Case reference: 2014003688.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1981, William Earnshaw was hunting in the Clemenceau District, Saskatchewan, southwest of Hudson Bay, Saskatchewan. He had separated from two companions and failed to meet at their vehicle in the evening. An extensive search of the area has failed to locate William.

Case reference: 2014032019.CaseDesc: On March 21, 1963, the dismembered remains of an unidentified man were found in burlap sacks on the side of the road near Pavilion, British Columbia. He had an old injury to his spine, likely causing pain and stooped posture, and was believed to have died a few months to years before being found.
